title: Local Guide Private Tampa City Tour by Golf Cart (Up to 5 riders)
includes: Guided narration of the visited districts
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be 6 years of age or older or provide the appropriate car seat
Digital Consent forms for all adults will be sent by text or Viator messaging app. Rider consent forms will need to be completed before the tour can start.

Please be aware that our starting point is in close proximity to Amalie Arena and if there are scheduled Hockey Games or Concerts parking may be difficult. Please prepare accordingly so we can start promptly at your scheduled booking time.
There is a 15 minute grace period if you are running late to the pick up spot. If more time is needed you must contact us
We operate one vehicle with a maximum on 5 guests. Duplicate bookings to accommodate additional guests cannot be fulfilled.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this tour, you and up to five guest will get to experience and see the full essence of Tampa. We will travel along the iconic Bayshore Boulevard, visit Old Hyde Park and see century old craftsman homes. 

While passing through Channel side we will visit the home of the Tampa Bay Lightning and Sparkman Wharf. In Ybor City we will encounter the cigar rolling culture of the old city and new waterfront at Armature Works in Tampa Heights.
